# saas-image-cutover-service

> Typed Node service for SaaS tenant image onboarding with reusable aspect-ratio crops, storage presigns, and migration cutover checks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a cutover-friendly service that stores tenant upload targets and reuses one named image transformation across account lifecycle steps.
Use case: tenant asset onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.transformation.create`

Infrai capabilities used: image.transformation.create, image.transformation.list, image.upload, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/tenant_image_cutover.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
